query:
SELECT a.id, a.full_name, a.email::text as "email?: String", r.label as "room_name" FROM accounts_people a LEFT JOIN res_leases l ON a.id = l.tenant_id
            LEFT JOIN res_rooms r ON l.room_id = r.id WHERE a.auth_id IS NULL AND a.full_name IS NOT NULL AND string_to_array(LOWER(a.full_name), ' ') @> string_to_array(LOWER($1), ' ') AND string_to_array(LOWER($1), ' ') @> string_to_array(LOWER(a.full_name), ' ')
